instruction: The "~/photographs/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/photographs/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

import os, time
spots = ['athens','maui','stockholm','tokyo']
results=[]
for spot in spots:
    dir_path = f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}"
    zip_path = f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip"
    r = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=dir_path, compressed_file_path=zip_path, access_token=access_token, delete_directory=False, overwrite=True)
    results.append((spot, r))
print(results)

import os
spots = ['athens','maui','stockholm','tokyo']
zip_paths = {spot: f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip" for spot in spots}
dir_paths = {spot: f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}" for spot in spots}
print('zip_paths', zip_paths)
# verify zips exist
zip_exists = {}
for spot in spots:
    z = zip_paths[spot]
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=z)
    zip_exists[spot]=exists.get('exists', None) if isinstance(exists, dict) else exists
print('zip_exists', zip_exists)
# delete directories
print('deleting dirs', dir_paths)
delete_results=[]
for spot in spots:
    d=dir_paths[spot]
    r=apis.file_system.delete_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=d)
    delete_results.append((spot,r))
print('delete_results', delete_results)
# verify dirs removed
remaining = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/photographs/vacations', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('remaining subdirs', remaining)
print('Compress and delete vacations complete. Zips created and directories deleted.')
